decisions.reason: Having survived the first review and remaining close to the core heat-exchanger portfolio in a growing firm, this product is likely still above the minimum aspiration level and worth retaining while learning continues.

Although it fits the established offer, the earlier withdrawal of a comparable condenser raises internal comparison pressure, so management would keep it only because its results likely appear better than the dropped alternative.
This repair-oriented extension directly supports the firm's service business and customer relationships, making it likely to stay unless it clearly falls short of modest aspiration levels.
